author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
In an interview with Bloomberg, Xbox boss Asha Sharma has admitted Game Pass was in a period of decline when she took over for former head Phil Spencer. But now they seemed to have stopped the bleeding, after dropping the price of the service and removing Call of Duty as a Day One title. Still, Xbox has admitted that the previous strategy of pumping money and resources into Game Pass has not paid off, and are now in the process of offloading some of the studios they've acquired to boost the service's value. In other news, Assassin's Creed: Black Flag - Resynced has already sold more in pre-orders than Ubisoft's other pirate game, Skull and Bones, has sold in its lifetime. And finally, IO Interactive has closed one of its studios—despite having a hit with 007: First Light—after Xbox funding for an upcoming game was pulled.
title: Xbox Boss Asha Sharma Admits Game Pass Strategy Has Failed - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
While Fenris previously hesitated to use the term "extraction shooter," that's very much the core of EVE Vanguard's Operation Avalon at the moment. You beam down to the planet in a clone body, try to collect as many resources as possible, and beam out before you get annihilated by other players or the NPC baddies of Mordu's Legion guarding the juiciest loot. There's no closing circle and no victory royale – just the promise of higher risk for higher rewards.

title: EVE Vanguard Reinvented Its Gameplay With Some Notes from Battlefield 6 | Hands-On Preview

description:
Jubilee takes the spotlight in this latest Marvel Rivals trailer for the third-person team-shooter action game. Check it out to see the character in action as she joins the Marvel Rivals roster in Season 9.

Jubilation Lee enters the battlefield with flying sparks. She's ready to ignite the battlefield with firework displays that are almost as explosive as her personality! 

Due to the effects of the Timestream Entanglement, Jubilee's son, Shogo, became trapped in his dragon form. Desperate to save him, Jubilee sought help from Apocalypse in Thebes, and in exchange, she became his Horseman of Famine. 

Ready to fight the world and be a shining beacon for her son, Jubilee generates bursts of pyrotechnic plasma as she shapes radiant energy into vibrant projectiles that shimmer with gleaming light. Combined with her vampiric powers, every firework she releases is an invigorating celebration on the battlefield! 

Marvel Rivals is available on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox

author: IGN
description:
Xbox is ‘not healthy’, but losing all of this talent isn’t the cure – Arkane, Compulsion, Double Fine, Ninja Theory, and Undead Labs deserve better. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma terms a "reset" for Xbox, but could this reset be the sign of the end of Xbox? Closing Tango Gameworks, Arkane Austin, the cancellation of Perfect Dark, and more, it's been a bleak few years for Microsoft and Xbox. So, what now, Xbox? Is the cure to go all-in on a handful of decades-old “mega franchises” like Halo, The Elder Scrolls, and Call of Duty? It’s a big bet. Let’s see if it pays off.

#IGN #Xbox #XboxLayOffs
title: Xbox Is ‘Not Healthy’, But Losing All of This Talent Isn’t the Cure
